title: Plasma should provide an easy way to open its user manual on KDE Linux
line: A "Plasma User Manual" entry in the launcher's Help category opens the Plasma handbook, online when KHelpCenter isn't installed.
explanation: Plasma's handbook was only reachable through KHelpCenter, which KDE Linux doesn't ship (it also deletes offline docs), so there was no way to open it from the desktop. On top of that, kde-open could not open help:/ URLs at all without KHelpCenter: KIO handed them to kioexec, which can't stat help: URLs and showed "file not found". plasma-desktop now installs a "Plasma User Manual" entry (Help category, found by searching "manual", "help", "handbook"…) that runs kde-open help:/plasma-desktop, and kde-open now sends help:/ URLs to the matching docs.kde.org page in the user's language when no help:/ handler is installed, while KHelpCenter keeps opening them when it is.

commits.message:
Add a Plasma User Manual entry to the application menu

Distributions that don't ship KHelpCenter, like KDE Linux, had no way to
reach the Plasma handbook from the desktop. The new Help entry opens it
in KHelpCenter when installed, and on docs.kde.org otherwise.

BUG: 509464

kde-open: open help URLs on docs.kde.org without a help viewer

Without KHelpCenter nothing handles help:/ URLs, so kde-open failed on
them with a "file not found" error. Now it opens the same page of the
online documentation, in the user's language, when no viewer is around.

BUG: 509464

patches.diff:
From 3905f403b414a29c7b837ac574ac031933ba7da4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:04:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Add a Plasma User Manual entry to the application menu

Distributions that don't ship KHelpCenter, like KDE Linux, had no way to
reach the Plasma handbook from the desktop. The new Help entry opens it
in KHelpCenter when installed, and on docs.kde.org otherwise.

BUG: 509464
---
 CMakeLists.txt                    | 1 +
 org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop | 9 +++++++++
 2 files changed, 10 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop

diff --git a/CMakeLists.txt b/CMakeLists.txt
index 06d26b072f..789494db32 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -291,6 +291,7 @@ add_subdirectory(emojier)
 add_subdirectory(kded)
 
 install(FILES org.kde.plasmashell.metainfo.xml DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_METAINFODIR})
+install(PROGRAMS org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_APPDIR})
 
 # Only link Discover to debian files in the debian world.
 find_program(DPKG dpkg)
diff --git a/org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop b/org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..d6075b49ff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/org.kde.plasma.usermanual.desktop
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Exec=kde-open help:/plasma-desktop
+Icon=system-help
+Name=Plasma User Manual
+Comment=Learn how to use Plasma
+Keywords=help;handbook;documentation;manual;guide;
+Categories=Qt;KDE;Core;Documentation;
+OnlyShowIn=KDE;
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, no KHelpCenter: the launcher's Help category has no way to open the Plasma manual.
With the fix: "Plasma User Manual" is listed under Help.
Master, no KHelpCenter and no offline docs (like KDE Linux): kde-open help:/plasma-desktop fails with an error.
Clicking "Plasma User Manual" opens the Plasma Handbook on docs.kde.org in the browser.
Master: searching "manual" in the launcher finds nothing for Plasma.
With the fix the search finds "Plasma User Manual".
